title: tool.open
description: Opens a split or a tab running a built-in tool and returns its number at once (ADR-0045). The core starts the `pinfold` binary beside it, never one found through PATH, with a fixed argument list and the caller's values after `--`: `pinfold md -- <path>` started in the file's directory, `pinfold files -- <path>` and `pinfold diff [--staged] -- [range]` started in `path`. Every check runs before any process starts: `path` must be absolute and exist, a file for md and a directory for files and diff, and only diff takes `staged` and `range`. No caller can type into a tool pane: pane.send to one is refused for every caller, including the one that opened it. pane.list shows it with kind `tool`. Reach, focus and caps are as for pane.spawn, the new pane joins the caller's children scope, and a sandboxed caller is refused. Needs hello version 2 and a caller in a pane.

tool.description: The markdown reader, the file manager or the git diff viewer.

path.description: An absolute path with no NUL: an existing file for md, an existing directory for files, and a repository's directory for diff.

staged.description: diff only: show the staged changes.

range.description: diff only: a revision or range. It does not start with -, holds only A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ / ~ ^ @ { } -, and at most one .. or ...; anything else is refused.

place.description: A split of the pane `of`, or a new tab after the others.

of.description: The pane to split: the caller's own, the default, or one it spawned.
